This is the second independent covering task for C-8034934c (fix cython source for numpy 2.x api compatibility); the reference task basalt-mantle embeds the capability as one of seven repairs, while this task exercises it in isolation end-to-end (diagnose removed APIs, port setup.py and .pyx, produce an offline build script).
notes: Single focused port: the vendored Cython package fails to build because setup.py uses numpy.distutils (removed in numpy 2.0) and gridcore.pyx calls PyArray_FromDims (removed C API). Agent must diagnose, port both files without changing rms/scale semantics, and leave an idempotent offline build script. Verifier executes port.sh, re-runs setup.py independently, greps that the removed APIs are gone, and probes the compiled module on hidden numeric edge cases (zero-entry grid, negatives, empty vector, fractional/zero factors, input immutability). Medium: debugging_ambiguity (build failures must be diagnosed from errors), tool_breadth (setuptools/Cython/numpy build plumbing), one dependency chain (sources -> build -> import), quantitative_correctness on hidden values.
